edges.details: Coinbase provides the borrower interface; Morpho holds collateral and executes the onchain lending market.
Coinbase's official product material includes XRP among supported collateral assets.
Coinbase's backup collateral table maps XRP loans to cbXRP on Base at contract 0xcb585250f852c6c6bf90434ab21a00f02833a4af.
Published reserve 151,405,263.6 XRP backs 151,403,016.069 cbXRP across 20 listed XRPL addresses; underlying backing is stated not to be sold, transferred or used for another purpose.
The market pairs cbXRP collateral with USDC debt and has a fixed 62.5% LLTV.
Market-wide borrowed amount is approximately $59.1M at the 00:31 UTC snapshot.
Circle Mint and APIs support native USDC on Base; Circle is the loan-asset issuer, not thereby a lender to this market.
USDC is also natively available on XRPL; this separate deployment does not establish a direct Base↔XRPL transfer route.

edges.from_entity: Steakhouse, Clearstar, K3, Gauntlet and Yearn vaults
edges.details: Nine listed vaults provide $58.56M of $65.42M supplied; top three provide $52.28M, approximately 79.9% of total market supply.
Morpho app lists ChainlinkOracleV2, 1-day heartbeat and 0.5% deviation for the collateral price feed.
The market displays a 12.67–12.68% liquidation bonus; this is distinct from Coinbase Help's unresolved 4.38% penalty statement.
This limits claims that the loan product mechanically generates Coinbase spot XRP buying.
No exact address match; this does not rule out indirect ownership or historical transfers.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: All cbXRP/USDC market borrow is Coinbase-originated.
disconfirming_evidence.evidence: Morpho market is permissionless; Coinbase has not disclosed interface share or market ID; any cbXRP holder can borrow directly.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: Circle is the lender because USDC is the loan asset.
disconfirming_evidence.evidence: Morpho lists Steakhouse, Clearstar, K3, Gauntlet and Yearn vaults as suppliers; no Circle supply position is identified.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: USDC borrowing creates XRP buying pressure.
disconfirming_evidence.evidence: Coinbase reports proceeds cannot be used to trade on Coinbase; no external onward purchase flow was traced.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: Morpho liquidations necessarily become native XRP spot sales.
disconfirming_evidence.evidence: Liquidators receive cbXRP; no end-to-end unwrap/redemption/XRPL or CEX sale path is established.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: Coinbase cbXRP backing overlaps the Binance incident wallet cluster.
disconfirming_evidence.evidence: The 20 Coinbase reserve addresses have zero exact string matches with the five Binance incident source wallets.
